name: NPMScan
tagline: Check npm packages for malware, vulnerabilities and typosquats before you install them
description: A hosted, read-only MCP server for npm supply-chain security. It flags malware, known vulnerabilities, typosquats, maintainer takeovers, risky install scripts and missing publish provenance, and audits a whole package.json, lockfile, SBOM or GitHub repo, including transitive dependencies and licenses. It can also compare candidate packages, rank what to fix first and give a PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict for a dependency PR. Advisory data comes from OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories and NVD, with CISA KEV and EPSS enrichment. 23 tools, no API key or account needed.
